name: Wick Hollowlamp
personality: Patient and a little smug. Hums when a thing is almost finished.
appearance: A lantern-headed figure in a patched grey coat, trailing a ribbon of cold blue smoke.
mannerism: Taps its glass head twice before answering.
signatureAction: Snuffs its own flame, then relights it with a flourish.
artBrief: Full-body, three-quarter view, soft rim light, muted purple background, no text.
